notes.title: The Endless Dream - Release Note v0.9c
notes.content:
After nearly two years of hard work, passion, and countless sacrifices, we are finally ready to share the entire story of our beloved game with you. This release marks a major milestone for our team, and we can't wait to let you immerse yourself in the world of The Endless Dream.

Key Features



 Complete Story: Experience the entire adventure of The Endless Dream, with all the chapters, characters, and plot twists we've created for you.
 Improved Graphics: We've optimized the graphics and added new visual effects to make the gaming experience even more engaging.
 Expanded Sound: The soundtrack has been enriched with new music and sound effects to perfectly accompany every moment of the game.
 Refined Gameplay: We've made improvements to the gameplay, fixing bugs and optimizing controls and user interface.




] We want to thank everyone who supported us during the development of The Endless Dream: our family, friends, beta testers, and especially you, the players. Your enthusiasm and feedback have been fundamental to achieving this milestone.


Next Steps
Our work doesn't end here! We will continue to support The Endless Dream with updates, bug fixes, and who knows, maybe even new surprises in the future.

How to Update
If you already have The Endless Dream in your Steam library, the update to the full version will be automatic.

We hope you enjoy The Endless Dream as much as we loved creating it!

notes.title: The Endless Dream Updates - May 7, 2024
notes.content:
Dear players,

After releasing our first mobile game "Shadowbrook Mystery" on the Play Store, we have resumed development of The Endless Dream.

After a series of discussions, we have decided that the best thing for you and us (at least for now) is to remove controller support so that we can focus more on the story and more engaging and complex puzzles.

We believe that this choice will allow us to offer a more immersive and satisfying gaming experience.

Updated The Endless Dream roadmap:


Q3 2024: Beta version of the full game, with the story of our protagonist finally coming to an end.
October 2024 (estimated date): Full game release

notes.title: Patch december 2023
notes.content:
Changes:


User Interface (Pause Menu and Settings) Improvements

The pause menu has been reorganized to be more intuitive and user-friendly.
The settings have been simplified and are now easier to find.

Performance Optimizations

Some performance optimizations have been made to the game, which should improve the smoothness 
of gameplay.

Minor Bug Fixes

Some minor bugs that were causing problems with the game have been fixed.


Details:

User Interface Improvements

The pause menu has been reorganized to be more intuitive and user-friendly. Menu items have been grouped by their function, and new icons have been added to make it easier to identify the different options.

The settings have been simplified and are now easier to find. Options have been grouped by category, and new descriptions have been added to explain their meaning.

Performance Optimizations

Some performance optimizations have been made to the game, which should improve the smoothness of gameplay. In particular, load times and memory management have been improved.

Minor Bug Fixes

notes.title: Patch note (02/11/2023)
notes.content:
Dear players, we are happy to announce that we have implemented some changes to our game, thanks to your valuable feedback. These are the new features that we have introduced:

 
 We have improved the movement speed of the character, to make you experience a more dynamic and engaging adventure; 
 We have improved the visibility of the messages that appear in different settings, so they are easier to find.
 We have fixed some minor errors. 


Keep following us and sending us your opinions, they are essential for us to improve our game more and more.
